name: Docker benchmark runner
tagline: Resolve BDN targets and run suites inside the Lyo benchmarks container.
description: Compose-backed runner. Default starts the container detached and returns immediately. Mid-run mounts update docs/benchmarks/data as each suite finishes.

commands.blurb: Build/start one suite in the background (returns immediately)
Foreground logs; quote globs so the shell does not expand them
Detached run that blocks until the container exits (then host history sync)
Rebuild the image without starting a suite
List resolved project names for a filter

notes: entrypoint.py runs run_dotnet.py inside the container
Default is background; use --wait or --fg if you want the CLI to block
With --wait/--fg on success, run.py also calls build_manifests.py --sync-portfolio-only as a host safety net (no-op if apps/gateway is absent)
